## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (92%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Severity-3 blur on this simulated frozen section flagged low reliability, prompting drafted recut, deeper levels, and margin deferral [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 92%, InSitu 4%, Normal 3%, Invasive 1% (ECE 5%, n=132) [F1] | Strong benign score; small test set |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% target (alpha 10%; coverage 90% [76%–98%], n=132) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee only |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 44% (flagged), OOD 100th percentile, 12 tiles kept (AUROC 0.70) [F6] | Suspect blurred input; out of distribution |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign (77%–82%), 2/5 Normal (78%, contrast BACH_0088) [F5] | Mixed Benign and Normal neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.20, contribution -0.71) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.56, contribution -0.62) favors non-invasive glands [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 11) · context · Below-typical descriptive score (+0.21, contribution +0.33) [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Below-average score (z=-0.22, contribution +0.29); failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top-3 risk regions lowers P(invasive) beyond random removal (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132), supporting classifier faithfulness.
- **Concepts**: Deletion overlaps zero (+0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064); normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), and necrosis (3/20) failed AI spot checks (unreliable).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 blur and out-of-distribution quality (44% reliability) mask atypia or invasion in high-risk regions 0, 4, and 6.
- CONCH–MUSK disagreement or similarity to Normal cases (2/5 neighbors; BACH_0088) reflects misclassification, with HoVer-Net cell segmentation disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4, 6**: Highest heatmap risk (73%, 72%, 45%); inspect directly through blur for occult stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 0, 8**: Margin segments reach 92%–97% (inferior/medial 97%, superior 92%); defer margins and review drafted recut/deeper levels.
3. **Regions 1, 9, 10, 11**: Verify benign tubule architecture (1, 9, 10) and sparse TILs (11) supporting the benign call.
